errors.quote: The first $b+1\le K$ rounds process bits one at a time, exactly, costing $O(TpdK)$.
errors.problem: The rounds on prefix slots are not the first $b+1$. In the paper the round at $h=\ell-1$ on the long axes comes first, then the $qK$ chunk rounds for $h=\ell-2,\dots,b$, and the bottom positions $h=b-1,\dots,0$ come last (the opposite procedure runs this in reverse). The cost is unaffected, but the schedule is misdescribed.

errors.quote: The contraction $\mathcal T_+$ adds error below $\delta$, so $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+z_*\|_\infty<3\delta+\eta$.
errors.problem: The exact contraction $\mathcal T_+$ adds no error. The paper's bound is $\|\widetilde h-\mathcal T_+\widetilde z\|+\|\mathcal T_+(\widetilde z-z_*)\|$: the first term is the computed opposite procedure's own error ($<\delta$), and the contraction keeps the propagated $2\delta+\eta$ from growing.

$\widetilde z$, $z_*$ (and later $\widetilde h$) are never defined on the page. The paper sets $\widetilde z=Q_p(P(\widetilde u,\widetilde v))$, $z_*=P(u,v)$, and takes $\widetilde h$ to be the returned opposite output.
